source_title: Emma Roberts Celebrates Aunt Julia Roberts’ 59th Birthday with Sweet Photo Together: ‘I Love You Beyond!’ - People.com
source_excerpt:
The ‘American Horror Story’ star posted a sweet tribute for her 59th birthday
On Oct. 28, Emma Roberts celebrated her aunt Julia Roberts’ 59th birthday with a sweet social media post
The Academy Award winner attended Emma’s outdoor Idaho wedding to Cody John in July
The actresses looked like twins as they walked a red carpet together in 2025 for the first time in 13 years
Emma Roberts is celebrating her aunt Julia Roberts !
“happy birthday Aunt Julia 👑 i love you beyond!!” the newly married American Horror Story actress, 35, captioned a photo of them together on Instagram on Wednesday, Oct. 28.
The Pretty Woman movie star turned 59 years old, and Emma marked the special occasion with a sweet photo of her being hugged by her aunt as they both smiled at the camera in coordinating colors.
Emma’s father, actor Eric Roberts , is Julia’s older brother.
While public photos of the leading ladies together are rare, the pair are known to be close and support each other.
When the Scream Queens actress tied the knot with Cody John during an outdoor ceremony in Idaho on July 25, Julia was in attendance , according to photos published by Page Six .
In September 2025, Emma and Julia walked the same red carpet together for the first time in 13 years when they both attended the Veuve Clicquot x Simon Porte Jacquemus party for New York Fashion Week.
For the special event, the duo looked like twins with similarly colored hair, and both opted for black wardrobe pieces.
Prior to that, their last red carpet appearance together was in 2012 at the premiere of the film Jesus Henry Christ .
Emma has also spoken fondly about growing up with the Academy Award winner.
“You would have to drag me off set,” the Aquamarine alum said of spending time with Julia at work during a May 2014 appearance on The Queen Latifah Show .
“I would go and visit, and my mom would be like, ‘Aren’t you bored? Don’t you wanna leave?’ I’m like, ‘No, I’m working in hair and make-up now,” she said while laughing. “And my mom would be like, ‘You’re 7, you’re … no!’ ”
She also gave a glimpse of what it was like to hang out on some of Julia’s biggest Hollywood projects.

“I remember I was on Erin Brockovich , that set, a lot, and you remember all her costumes in that movie were, like, very scandalous, and I would always, like, sneak into the trailer, put them on, and like, the big padded boob costume and I was just obsessed,” Emma recalled while smiling. “It was so fun.”
In January 2023, the Space Cadet star gushed over some of her aunt’s favorite roles during a visit to Watch What Happens Live , where she said “her favorite” rom-com is her aunt’s 1997 film My Best Friend’s Wedding .
